{{Quote|If this isn’t the real thing, I come back and kill you good.''"<br />"''It's real, it's real.|Aqualish assassin to Rodian dealer|<ref name="MK" />}}
This '''individual''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] dealer of [[Glitterstim bite|glitterstim bites]] at a [[Unidentified Coruscant pedestrian market|pedestrian market]] on the  [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="MK" />

In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> the Rodian sold glitterstim bites to an [[Unidentified Aqualish assassin|Aqualish]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] at the market. The Aqualish warned the Rodian that if the spice was not genuine, he would return and [[Death/Legends|kill]] him. Frightened, the Rodian assured the Aqualish that it was genuine and gave him an extra bag of glitterstim bites free of charge before fleeing.<ref name="MK" />
